notes: This run is using CQI-driven link adaptation. The transmitted MCS/modulation should follow the receiver Hest/CSI wideband SINR and CQI path exported by the trial tables, not a decoder-truth SINR measurement.

Warmup rows can still show the configured starting MCS before the first CQI-driven decision is applied. Use IsWarmupFrame and LinkAdaptationApplied in the trial tables to separate pre-adaptation rows from steady-state AMC behavior.

Scheduler grants are the applied operating-point authority for at least one direction in this run. Use ConfiguredMCSSelectionPolicy, SchedulerGrantMCSSelectionMode, and AppliedOperatingPointSource to separate configured intent from transmitted reality.
Mobility is enabled in the exported LLS layout context. Geometry/map artifacts reflect the configured deployment and mobility settings.
Current live stage: system_level_completed. system_level_link_to_system_phy_no_coupled_signal_gating; canonical adapter published grant-backed DL/UL trials and reports
Interference mode: abstract_large_scale_scheduler_context. This run is still using explicit coupled large-scale interference context rather than summed interferer waveforms.
Active channel-array handling status: link_to_system_sinr_context_no_per_grant_waveform_channel_object.
Serving channel object source: sixgr.system.AbstractPHY.decode.
Serving channel-array blocker: link_to_system_backend_consumes_sinr_context_not_runtime_waveform_channel_objects.
The serving channel did not use the same antenna assumptions as the runtime BS/UE objects.
Interference channel-array handling status: large_scale_interference_budget_no_runtime_interferer_channel_object.
Interference channel object source: system_level_interference_budget_without_explicit_interferer_waveform_objects.
Interference channel-array blocker: system_level_interference_budget_does_not_materialize_interferer_channel_objects.
Serving and interferer channel paths did not use the same channel-array handling level.
The interferer channel path did not use the same antenna assumptions as the runtime antenna objects.
Noise operating mode: receiver_noise_figure_thermal_noise. The active waveform path derives receive noise from thermal noise plus receiver noise figure.
Control/access integration mode: system_level_link_to_system_phy_no_coupled_signal_gating. Control outputs are still not gating the active data path.
PUCCH mode: not_materialized_in_system_level_lls. PUCCH is not running through the explicit waveform-backed coupled feedback path.
TRS mode: not_materialized_in_system_level_lls. TRS is not active in the current runtime path.
TRS runtime consumer: not_runtime_consumed_in_system_level_lls.
TRS did not influence a downstream runtime decision in the sampled runtime context.
TRS receiver integration blocker: system_level_runner_has_no_runtime_trs_trial_or_tracker_state.
Doppler source mode: derive_from_ue_speed. The runtime channel Doppler is derived from UE speed and carrier frequency for this scenario.
Parallel grant execution: not active: parallel_not_requested.

ReceiverHestSINR_dB is a receiver-side wideband effective SINR estimate from Hest and CSI feedback. DecoderTruthProxySINR_dB is a derived post-equalization EVM proxy. LargeScaleSINR_dB remains a large-scale preview, not decoder truth.

Raw DL/UL trial row finalization is now driven by primary runtime decode/grant truth. Secondary gaps such as preview SINR or optional linkage stay in per-field status columns and SecondaryFieldGap* instead of forcing RowLifecycleState=partial.
Roundtrip verifier artifacts are being read from canonical DB-backed CSVs and surfaced directly in the browser live payload.
At least one roundtrip verifier row is not marked consistent, so the browser should be treated as showing an active mismatch rather than a clean roundtrip.

Canonical artifacts exist but are empty for: live_control_gating_state -> reports/csv/live_control_gating_state.csv, raw_control_trials.pbch_trials -> air_interface/csv/pbch_trials.csv, raw_control_trials.pdcch_trials -> air_interface/csv/pdcch_trials.csv, raw_control_trials.prach_trials -> air_interface/csv/prach_trials.csv, raw_control_trials.pucch_trials -> air_interface/csv/pucch_trials.csv, raw_control_trials.srs_trials -> air_interface/csv/srs_trials.csv, raw_control_trials.trs_trials -> air_interface/csv/trs_trials.csv, raw_link_trials.ul -> air_interface/csv/ul_pusch_trials.csv, scheduler_grants.pucch -> packet_flow/csv/live_pucch_grants.csv, scheduler_grants.ul -> packet_flow/csv/live_ul_scheduler_grants.csv, trs_trials -> air_interface/csv/trs_trials.csv. The browser is not silently replacing these with legacy mirrors.
